$comment: Pinned hyperai-skills source for the hyperai profile installer. `ref` is a commit, never a branch: the repository has been history-rewritten before, and an unpinned tap would silently change what the profile loads. `verified` lists skills/ (repo-verified area); `unverified` lists inbox/ candidates that install only with --include-unverified and stay labelled unverified in the manifest.

unverified.note: needs MINERU_API_KEY + network to a self-hosted MinerU endpoint; parsers currently drop <th> header cells

unverified.name: mineru-ocr-to-xlsx
unverified.note: prompt-only walkthrough; offline conversion path exercised in this repo's verification
